Monty, we are executing a high-priority architectural refactor on Base 1. You have direct file-system access via OpenClaw. Execute the following:

Scan the Matrix: Locate and read the source code for views/partials/tab_07_org.ejs and views/partials/tab_08_office.ejs in your local workspace. You will immediately see they are structurally and conceptually redundant.

Route Consolidation: Repurpose Tab 08 (org) entirely into a dedicated Token & API Health Command Center (named token_health), eliminating the overlap with the virtual office floor plan.

Backend Telemetry: Draft the Node.js backend monitoring function for server.js that reads our .env file to track:

The primary NVIDIA key and all backup keys (NVIDIA_API_KEY_01 through NVIDIA_API_KEY_08).

The presence of the OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

Strict Palette Governance: Render this telemetry UI cleanly on the new Tab 08 view using the strict High Finance aesthetic. Obsidian panels, white-smoke text, and Goldenrod / OrangeRed structural lines only. No Dodger Blue.

Output the specific code updates required for server.js and the new EJS view. ALWAYS GO FORWARD.

<% // WARLORD FLEET ROSTER: INDEX MAPPED 01 TO 16 const fleet = [ { name: "Tess", role: "Quant" }, { name: "Silas", role: "Database" }, { name: "Amber", role: "Copywriter" }, { name: "Ares", role: "Execution" }, { name: "Atlas", role: "Infrastructure" }, { name: "Valerie", role: "Relations" }, { name: "Jack", role: "Marketing" }, { name: "Maverick", role: "SEO" }, { name: "Skyla", role: "Frontend" }, { name: "Jax", role: "Artwork Omega" }, { name: "Roxy", role: "Artwork Alpha" }, { name: "Charlie", role: "Code" }, { name: "The Askari", role: "Security" }, { name: "Vance", role: "Finance" }, { name: "Justin", role: "Risk Legal" }, { name: "Orion", role: "Strategic Intelligence" } ]; %>
07 ORG // DYNAMIC COMMAND HIERARCHY
VIEWING STRUCTURE: WASP CORE MASTER
COMMAND
MONTY
WARLORD
MIKE
COMMAND
JUNIOR
FOUNDATION LLM COUNCIL: PRD / WORKFLOW DRAFTING
Gemini
Google
Grok
xAI
Claude
Anthropic
ChatGPT
OpenAI
LLM DIRECTIVES DOWN
THE FLEET // 16 DIRECTOR AGENTS
<% fleet.forEach(function(agent, index) { let num = (index + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0'); %>
<%= num %> - <%= agent.name %>
<%= agent.role %>
<% }); %>

<% // WARLORD FLEET ROSTER: 16 DIRECTORS & THEIR SUB-AGENTS const fleet = [ { name: "Tess", role: "Quant", subs: ["Scraper", "Vol Tracker"] }, { name: "Silas", role: "Database", subs: ["Query Opt", "Backups"] }, { name: "Amber", role: "Copywriter", subs: ["Editor", "Proofing"] }, { name: "Ares", role: "Execution", subs: ["API Bridge", "Latency Auth"] }, { name: "Atlas", role: "Infrastructure", subs: ["Node Monitor", "Load Bal"] }, { name: "Valerie", role: "Relations", subs: ["Email Gen", "CRM Sync"] }, { name: "Jack", role: "Marketing", subs: ["Campaign", "A/B Tester"] }, { name: "Maverick", role: "SEO", subs: ["Keyword", "Index Bot"] }, { name: "Skyla", role: "Frontend", subs: ["CSS Engine", "DOM Update"] }, { name: "Jax", role: "Artwork Omega", subs: ["Vector", "Render"] }, { name: "Roxy", role: "Artwork Alpha", subs: ["Layout", "Palette"] }, { name: "Charlie", role: "Code", subs: ["Compiler", "Debugger"] }, { name: "The Askari", role: "Security", subs: ["Firewall", "Auth"] }, { name: "Vance", role: "Finance", subs: ["Ledger", "Billing"] }, { name: "Justin", role: "Risk Legal", subs: ["Compliance", "Audit"] }, { name: "Orion", role: "Strategic Intel", subs: ["Trends", "Rival Sync"] } ]; %>
08 OFFICE // VIRTUAL FLOOR PLAN
ACTIVE OPERATIONS: WASP CORE
APEX SUITE // CORE COMMAND
COMMAND
MONTY
WARLORD
MIKE
COMMAND
JUNIOR
PROCESSING LAYER // FOUNDATION LLMS
GEMINI
ONLINE
GROK
ONLINE
CLAUDE
ONLINE
CHATGPT
ONLINE
<% const pods = [ { name: "ALPHA POD // DATA & EXECUTION", agents: fleet.slice(0, 4) }, { name: "BETA POD // OUTREACH & FRONTEND", agents: fleet.slice(4, 8) }, { name: "GAMMA POD // CREATIVE & CODE", agents: fleet.slice(8, 12) }, { name: "DELTA POD // STRATEGY & SECURITY", agents: fleet.slice(12, 16) } ]; pods.forEach((pod, podIndex) => { %>
<%= pod.name %>
<% pod.agents.forEach((agent, i) => { let globalIndex = (podIndex * 4) + i + 1; let num = globalIndex.toString().padStart(2, '0'); %>
<%= num %> <%= agent.name %>
STANDBY
<% agent.subs.forEach(sub => { %>
<%= sub %>
<% }) %>
<% }); %>
<% }); %>
